title: Fun in Music City
description:
Steeped in Southern traditions of hospitality and charm, you’ll want for nothing as you adventure day and night in Music City. Luckily, this warm, friendly resort is close to Nashville’s best music and historical landmarks, like the Country Music Hall of Fame and the downtown Broadway area.
Located just one mile from the Grand Ole Opry, Club Wyndham Nashville provides a great base to explore all the middle Tennessee has to offer.
